company.shortDescription: Hyperspell is your Company Brain. Connects your tools, builds a context graph, and surfaces it as an updating filesystem any agent can read.
company.description: Hyperspell is your Company Brain. A living, permissioned understanding of how your organization works. Hyperspell connects your tools and synthesizes them into a live context graph. Any agent can query it as a filesystem, with every fact traced to source.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,700,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $23,700,000 to $23,700,000, a 1x increase.
